turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How much should I budget per day in Mexico City? I'm a student, so, not much.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You can do it fairly cheaply. A hostel bed, street food and the metro keep costs very low.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Many backpackers spend somewhere around thirty to forty dollars a day, but prices change, so check recent travel forums.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We're moving next month and I'm stuck on how to actually do the move.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, a handful of options. Listen first, I'll say when I'm finished.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first option is hiring a full service moving company that packs everything, but it's expensive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's renting a big truck and getting friends to help in exchange for pizza.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is one of those portable storage containers they drop off and pick up later.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is hiring movers just for the heavy furniture and packing the rest ourselves.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Um, I think I'm done. Yeah. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hiring movers just for the heavy stuff is often the sweet spot, you save money and your back. The full service company is worth it if you're short on time. The truck with friends is cheapest, but it depends on how reliable your friends are.
